items.title: Pembina Pipeline Q2 Earnings Miss Estimates, Revenues Increase Y/Y
items.summary: PBA misses Q2 EPS estimates, but revenues rise 20% year over year as higher volumes and operational strength lift results across its business segments.

items.title: PARR Q2 Earnings Beat Estimates on Refining Margin Strength
items.summary: Par Pacific's Q2 earnings soared 555.8% and revenues jumped 56.8%, beating estimates as refining margins surged despite lower throughput and softer retail results.

items.title: TechnipFMC Q2 Earnings & Revenues Beat Estimates, Rise Y/Y
items.summary: FTI tops Q2 earnings and revenue estimates as Subsea strength lifts margins and sales, while reaffirming full-year 2026 guidance and shareholder returns.

items.title: ProPetro Q2 Loss Wider Than Expected, Revenues Beat Estimates
items.summary: PUMP expects 2026 capital expenditures of $525-$595 million, with Completions spending projected at $125-$145 million and PROPWR spending expected to be $400-$450 million.

items.title: Patterson-UTI Energy Q2 Earnings & Revenues Beat Estimates
items.summary: PTEN expects about 100 average U.S. rigs in Drilling Services during the third quarter, with adjusted gross profit projected at around $145 million.

items.title: Is Antero Midstream Stock Worth Buying Despite Its Premium Valuation?
items.summary: AM offers fee-based cash flows, rising volumes and a 4.1% dividend yield, though debt, customer concentration and a premium valuation temper the outlook.

items.title: Kinder Morgan Inc's Dividend Analysis
